title: Change Contract
note: Full Change Contract workflow lands in a later phase. This stub shows the shape for before/after review.

before.summary: getOrder(id, _uid) returns orders.get(id) with no ownership comparison.
before.risk: Any authenticated caller can read any order by id (IDOR).

after.summary: getOrder(id, uid) returns the order only when order.userId === uid; else null → 404.
after.expectedProof: Cross-user GET /orders/ord-2 as alice yields 404; owned fetch still 200.
